title: John Mulaney wins over critics on his seventh night hosting SNL
summary: Bowen Yang played Jensen Huang in a cold open set at the CIA, and Phoebe Bridgers was the musical guest.
body:
John Mulaney hosted Saturday Night Live for the seventh time on 14 November, in an episode that critics called one of the season's strongest.

The show opened with a sketch set at CIA headquarters, with Mulaney briefing a room of technology executives. Bowen Yang drew big laughs with a surprise appearance as former Nvidia boss Jensen Huang.

Reviews

The A.V. Club said Mulaney had pulled off the "almost impossible" on his seventh outing, though it noted the episode ran long. LateNighter praised his monologue for setting up ideas that ran through the rest of the night.

Phoebe Bridgers was the musical guest, performing songs from her album Lost Weekend.

Sources: The A.V. Club, LateNighter.
